items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: . . . was on some of the recordings.

Yeah. He was a character. Max Roach always stood out in my mind. During those days – Max was younger, and he had that heavy moustache. I don’t know if you remember that. Heavy, almost like Graucho Marx. I used to say, boy, that guy is so hip, the way he looked and the way he played, and the way he was able to play with them so that it made sense. It was like having a sixth finger or something. I always admired him. Then I met Tadd Dameron, and through Tadd, I met Max. Then I got the chance to talk with him. The…
